name: 終了日のある習慣の繰り返し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0017「終了日のある習慣の繰り返し」. ONE compact two-line recurrence-summary setting. Wide landscape canvas, component close framed with minimal white margin, no tall empty page.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL Finch controls the recurrence icon anatomy, stroke and optical weight, arrow placement, spacing and exact recurrence meaning. Scope ONLY source repeat summary at logical x18,y110,w354,h77. Image2 our mock is SECONDARY for Japanese layout and typography; it omitted original year2025, restore that year. Image3 approved bus is STYLE ONLY for white rounded surfaces, subtle outline and restrained soft depth.
One horizontally arranged white rounded card. On left original opposing arrows recurrence glyph (one rightward top arrow, one leftward lower arrow, same bent source geometry and rounded stroke), adapted to coherent slate#526173 in a small neutral light-gray circle. Center text block: small exact label「繰り返し」above exact Japanese summary「平日ごと・2025年8月30日まで」. Keep the whole summary legible; it may wrap to a second line rather than shrinking/clipping. At far right one down-chevron in slate, vertically centered. No modal close X, other settings, switches, save button, header or device frame.
Native typography preserved: label Meiryo Regular12px/16px, summary Meiryo Regular14px/24px, tracking0. Main ink#1D1D1D, secondary label#6E6E6E; do not bold the value or replace with allcaps. Logical row width354, original height77, allow minimum growth for Japanese wrapping. Corners18px, pure white canvas/card, fine neutral border and restrained shadow. Original blue icon circle is a decorative category cue; use neutral/slate in this isolated quiet secondary selector, no forced green action or colorful fill. Do not copy the mock's rough arrow substitute; original arrows govern. Preserve dates and weekday recurrence, no invented values. No gloss, glow, broad mint or watermark. Raster design candidate.
reviewNotes: Japanese recurrence summary inspected with restored2025 year, weekday schedule and Aug30 date. Original opposing-arrow geometry and single downchevron retained; mock year omission corrected. Source blue category fill neutralized to slate/light-neutral in this isolated setting; white card/fine border/soft shadow. Label and value remain regular weight. Exact native typography and selector behavior unproved.
